steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen specified by the case.
Set the event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title so publishing can proceed.
Choose the RFQ template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add one CYLINDER line item and set its requested quantity to 10.
Complete the pricing sheet fields required for the RFQ.
Invite one QA test vendor as required before publishing.
Open the schedule drawer from the footer.
Verify that the schedule drawer opened.
Choose custom duration rather than a preset.
Enter the requested two-hour custom duration.
Verify that the saved schedule summary reflects a two-hour duration.
Assert that publishing reached a real project page.
